description_en: Queries the ranking of cumulative application usage duration for a specified user within a date range
description_zh: 查询指定用户在日期范围内的应用累计使用时长排行
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center query-user-app-usage-time-rank --appstream-center-region-id cn-hangzhou --app-instance-group-id 'aig-9ciijz60n4xsv****' --start-date 20260901 --end-date 20260907 --user-id user01 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryUserAppUsageTimeRank

parameters.help_en: The region ID for OpenAPI access, which is used for request authentication and routing. To filter business data by region, use `BizRegionId`
parameters.help_zh: OpenAPI 接入地域 ID，用于请求鉴权和路由；业务数据的地域筛选请使用 `BizRegionId`
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The app instance group ID, which is used to filter data for a specified app instance group. If this parameter is not provided, data is not filtered by app instance group
parameters.help_zh: 交付组 ID，用于筛选指定交付组的数据；不传时不按交付组筛选
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The start date of the statistical period, in `yyyyMMdd` format. If this parameter is not provided, it defaults to yesterday. The date cannot be earlier than 90 days before the call date. The query range includes this date. The date is interpreted as a calendar date in the Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8) time zone
parameters.help_zh: 统计开始日期，格式：`yyyyMMdd`。不传时默认取昨天；日期不能早于调用日之前 90 天。查询范围包含该日期。按 Asia/Shanghai（UTC+8）的自然日期解释
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The end date of the statistical period, in `yyyyMMdd` format. If this parameter is not provided, it defaults to yesterday. The date cannot be earlier than `StartDate`, and cannot be earlier than 90 days before the call date. The query range includes this date. The date is interpreted as a calendar date in the Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8) time zone
parameters.help_zh: 统计结束日期，格式：`yyyyMMdd`。不传时默认取昨天；不能早于 `StartDate`，且不能早于调用日之前 90 天。查询范围包含该日期。按 Asia/Shanghai（UTC+8）的自然日期解释
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en: The ID of the end user to be queried. This parameter must be explicitly provided. If it is not provided, no matching records are usually returned
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的终端用户 ID。应显式传入；未传入时通常无匹配记录
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The business region ID, which is used to filter application usage data. If this parameter is not provided, data is not filtered by business region. You can call the [ListRegions](~~ListRegions~~) operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 业务地域 ID，用于筛选应用使用数据；不传时不按业务地域筛选。可调用 [ListRegions](~~ListRegions~~) 获取
parameters.name: biz_region_id

Code.description_en: The business status code. A value of `200` indicates that the request is processed successfully. Other values indicate that the processing failed
Code.description_zh: 业务状态码。`200` 表示请求处理成功；其他值表示处理失败

IndexData.description_en: The ranking list of user application usage duration, sorted in descending order of cumulative usage duration
IndexData.description_zh: 用户应用使用时长排行列表，按累计使用时长降序排列

AppTimeCnt.description_en: The cumulative usage duration of the application within the statistical range. Unit: seconds
AppTimeCnt.description_zh: 应用在统计范围内的累计使用时长。单位：秒

AppVersion.description_en: The application version. The current version may not return this value, and callers should not rely on this field. A non-empty value indicates the application version
AppVersion.description_zh: 应用版本。当前版本可能不返回该值，调用方不应依赖此字段；非空时表示应用版本

Message.description_en: The description of the request processing result. If the request is successful, `success` is usually returned
Message.description_zh: 请求处理结果说明。请求成功时通常返回 `success`

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used to troubleshoot request issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位请求问题
